classification_detail: 2 sorries: injOn_disk_of_injOn_circle (injectivity on disk) and surjOn_domain_of_injOn_circle (surjectivity onto domain). Both require the argument principle (counting preimages via contour integrals of g'/(g-w)), the Jordan curve theorem (injective image of circle bounds a domain), and winding number theory for simple closed curves — none of which are formalized in Mathlib at the required generality.

sorry_locations: injOn_disk_of_injOn_circle (injectivity on disk from injectivity on boundary)
blockers: Argument principle: (1/2πi) ∮ g'(z)/(g(z)-w) dz = number of preimages of w — not in Mathlib
Jordan curve theorem: injective continuous image of circle bounds a simply connected domain — not in Mathlib
Winding number of simple closed curve around interior point = ±1 — not in Mathlib
